body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: c2dcb516cca3ce99ad08df98e2340c7f187cf671 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The cylinder refusal mismatch from the earlier review is fixed. The field cylinder gate now counts with `cells_across`, the same count the column arm builds over the circumscribed square (`backend_build.rs`, `from_shape`). The class is closed with one rule, not with one site: every lattice sized from a length goes through `cells_across`, and an origin-locked lattice takes its edge cells by `edge_cells`. Both commits (2aec517e, 9bb47480) do what they say, and the mutation table in the PR body matches what the code does.

What looks good:
- One shared count, not one per site. `cells_across` in `kernel.rs` is the box/mesh/exact-carry/slab/lattice law; `edge_cells` is the edge-coordinate form of the same law.
- The optional field-backend case from the earlier review is in: `the_field_box_gate_counts_the_same_columns`.
- The arms agree at the 4096-cell boundary: the column arm builds it; the field arm passes the grid gate and refuses by name on its own per-facet budget; one real part of a cell more and both refuse in the same words.
- The pins live next to the code they pin, in the crate that owns the change.

Results on this head, trial-merged with origin/main (dc5a34dd1) - the merge is clean.
- Targeted sim tests, run locally at c2dcb516c (CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6, CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1):
  - `cell_count_tests` pins: 9 passed
  - camcraft-sim lib: 275 passed
  - stock_columns 4, stock_carry 7, stock_carry_side 14, stock_carry_side_exact 13, stock_cut_twin 12, stock_field_cost 4, stock_dual 5, stock_sdf 9, stock_sim 24, stock_backend_parity 13, stock_sdf_cut 12, laid_cylinder 2, field_block_cost 2 passed / 1 ignored
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

Not run here: the light lane. Its crates (kernel, motion, app) hold no light twin of this change. The author's quick gate at this head (83 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 29.6 min) is the evidence; heavy lanes are not owed at review.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes, not blocking:
- The remaining field-vs-column cylinder split is the field arm's per-facet cell budget (field_gen.rs, MAX_CELLS_PER_FACET). It refuses by name on both this head and main; #4047 tracks it. It is not this PR.
- The body's `Effort: high` matches the issue's label (effort:high); stock simulation is under the safety floor.
- The body says `Fixes #4012` and closes the issue it names; the pins match the issue's done criteria (50 columns, no material past the box edge, same count from the carry read).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
